_: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, architecture qwen4exp) in unsloth's UD-IQ2_XS GGUF, on the `maya` engine's Qwen path as CYBER-FROST runs (tools/iq_pack.py indexes the files in place). Three shards: 1 the metadata and tokenizer, 2 the weights (routed gate/up experts IQ2_S / IQ2_XXS, down IQ4_NL / Q2_0 and blk.4's Q5_0), 3 the n-gram table alone (IQ4_NL). Shards 1-2 and the MTP head (a separate GGUF: tools/mtp_from_gguf.py builds the drafter from its blk.48) come from unsloth's repo at the pinned revision; shard 3, byte for byte unsloth's (the same sha256), from Maya's own repo ("sources"). Every file has its sha256: the setup checks it. Pictures: download.json's "vision" (the same mmproj as CYBER-FROST's, shared on the disk). unsloth's other UD quants run on the same code; only UD-IQ2_XS is listed.
